excerpt.zh: 这一文明演化出了一种异养于其他智慧生命形态的寄生体。当它踏入星系舞台时，其他的物种或是被视作侍徒而带入他们的行列，要么就成为他们的食物。在食尸者面前，没有第三种选择。
excerpt.en: This civilization evolved as a parasite, forced to feed off other sapient life forms to sustain itself. As it arrives on the galactic stage, other species will either be brought into the fold, or become its food. For the necrophage, there can be no other way.

texts.zh: 这一文明演化出了一种异养于其他智慧生命形态的寄生体。当它踏入星系舞台时，其他的物种或是被视作侍徒而带入他们的行列，要么就成为他们的食物。在食尸者面前，没有第三种选择。
texts.en: This civilization evolved as a parasite, forced to feed off other sapient life forms to sustain itself. As it arrives on the galactic stage, other species will either be brought into the fold, or become its food. For the necrophage, there can be no other way.

sections.zh:
在并不遥远的过去，[GetHomeWorldName]被一个相当平凡的物种所统治着。在旁观者看来，他们似乎经历了标准的曲折发展历程，有偶然的高速创新时期也有大量看上去漫长而难以逾越的瓶颈。然而，不为他们所知的是，他们的星球已经成为了另一智慧物种——我们——的据点。

几千年来，我们——[GetSpeciesNamePlural]——并未被这颗星球的主人所发现。仅仅流传着一些夜晚的模糊的恐怖谣言，我们仅仅是被拿来恐吓不听话小孩的虚构人物。然而他们错误地低估了我们。

随着他们技术发展的加快，我们也加速渗透着他们的社会。他们迅速且血腥地沦陷。我们雷厉风行地掌控了他们的星球——这颗星球的前主人不得不屈服并逐渐成为[GetSpeciesName]的一员。

现在，实装了近期刚发现的超光速旅行秘密的我们已经准备好走向星河的舞台，并把全星系的所有物种改造成我们的样子！
sections.en:
In the not-so-distant past, [GetHomeWorldName] was dominated by a fairly unremarkable species. To all onlookers, they would have seemed to be following a standard meandering course of development, with occasionally rapid periods of innovation interspersed with much longer periods of seemingly insurmountable setbacks. However, unbeknownst to them, their planet was home to a second intelligent species: us.

For millennia, we - the [GetSpeciesNamePlural] - remained undetected by the planet's proprietors. Little more than vague rumors of terrors in the night, we were a fairytale told only to scare misbehaving juveniles. But they were wrong to discount us.

As their rate of technological progress quickened, so too did our infiltration of their society. When their fall came, it was swift and bloody. We ruthlessly took control of the planet - our precursors reduced to subservience and gradual absorption into the [GetSpeciesName] race.

Now armed with the recently-discovered secret of FTL travel, we are ready to take to the stars and remake all species of the galaxy in our likeness!

而如今我们已经掌握了超光速旅行的秘密，我们终于能够在群星间遨游，在未来的星系帝国舞台上夺得我们的一席之地！

Now armed with the recently-discovered secret of FTL travel, we are ready to reach for the stars and take our place among the spacefaring nations of the galaxy!

sections.en:
In the not-so-distant past, [GetHomeWorldName] was dominated by a fairly unremarkable species. To all onlookers, they would have seemed to be following a standard meandering course of development, with occasionally rapid periods of innovation interspersed with much longer periods of seemingly insurmountable setbacks. However, unbeknownst to them, their planet was home to a second intelligent species: us.

For millennia, we - the [GetSpeciesNamePlural] - remained undetected by the planet's proprietors. Little more than vague rumors of terrors in the night, we were a fairytale told only to scare misbehaving juveniles. But they were wrong to discount us.

As their rate of technological progress quickened, so too did our infiltration of their society. Finally, we were ready. The superiority of our collective consciousness became clear as we ruthlessly took control of the planet - our precursors reduced to subservience and gradual absorption into the [GetSpeciesName] hive mind.

Now armed with the recently-discovered secret of FTL travel, we are ready to take to the stars and remake all species of the galaxy in our likeness!

sections.zh:
在并不遥远的过去，那艘最终归属于我们的宏伟方舟，其上的船员都是一群相当平凡的物种。在旁观者看来，他们似乎经历了标准的曲折发展历程，有偶然的高速创新时期也有大量看上去漫长而难以逾越的瓶颈。然而，不为他们所知的是，他们的飞船中还潜藏着另一个智慧物种——我们。

几千年来，我们，[GetSpeciesNamePlural]，一直躲藏在飞船中那些被遗忘的走廊和封闭的舱室之中，从未被发现。我们不过是关于黑暗中恐怖之物的模糊传言，一个只是用来吓唬不听话小孩的恐怖传说。然而他们错误地低估了我们。

随着他们技术发展的加快，我们也加速渗透着他们的社会。

当他们的末日来临时，一切迅速而血腥。我们无情地夺取了飞船的控制权，飞船原本的主人沦为了附庸，并逐渐被[GetSpeciesName]所同化。

如今，方舟已归于我们之手，其航向亦由我们裁定。我们将踏星而行，穿越虚空。星海万族，终将被重塑为吾等之形！
sections.en:
In the not-so-distant past, the great arkship that would become ours was crewed by a fairly unremarkable species. To all onlookers, they would have seemed to be following a standard meandering course of development, with occasionally rapid periods of innovation interspersed with much longer periods of seemingly insurmountable setbacks. However, unbeknownst to them, their vessel harbored a second intelligent species: us.

For millennia, we, the [GetSpeciesNamePlural], remained undetected within the ship's forgotten corridors and sealed compartments. Little more than vague rumors of terrors in the dark, we were a fairytale told only to scare misbehaving juveniles. But they were wrong to discount us.

As their rate of technological progress quickened, so too did our infiltration of their society.

When their fall came, it was swift and bloody. We ruthlessly seized control of the vessel, our precursors reduced to subservience and gradual absorption into the [GetSpeciesName] race.

The arkship is ours now, its heading ours to set. We are ready to chart our own course through the stars and remake all species of the galaxy in our likeness!

texts.zh:
间谍首脑[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]报告我们失去了活跃于[from.spynetwork.target.GetName]上的[from.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer]特工的联系。他们已经错过了最近的几次约定的汇报时间。

按照标准程序，我们现在需要决定是否去追踪他们。
texts.en:
Spymaster [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] reports having lost contact with [from.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer] operatives on active deployment in the [from.spynetwork.target.GetName]. They have missed a number of their most recent, scheduled check-ins.

In accordance with standard procedure, we must now decide whether or not to track down our own operatives.

texts.zh: 我们的努力奏效了——同我方特工的联络恢复了。间谍首脑[fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName]已经开始着手审核[fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetHeShe]为了在[fromfrom.target.GetName]经营而布置好的监视流程。
texts.en: Our efforts proved successful - contact with our operatives has been restored. Spymaster [fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName] is already working to review the monitoring procedures [fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetHeShe] [fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetHasHave] in place for work in the [fromfrom.target.GetName].

texts.zh:
尽管我们已经尽全力，但我们还是没法恢复与我们在[fromfrom.target.GetName]的特工的通讯。间谍首脑[fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName]已经下达指令，对我们当地间谍网的监视流程进行一次评估；有可能[fromfrom.target.GetAdj]的加密手段比我们估计的还要高明。

于此同时，[fromfrom.GetName]行动将以未达到全力的情况下恢复，直到我们补充了损失的部分。
texts.en:
Despite our best efforts, we cannot restore contact with our operatives in the [fromfrom.target.GetName]. Spymaster [fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName] has ordered a review of monitoring procedures for our Spy Network there; it is possible the [fromfrom.target.GetAdj] have more sophisticated Encryption than we had thought.

Meanwhile, Operation [fromfrom.GetName] will resume at a reduced capacity while we recoup our losses.

texts.zh:
间谍首脑[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]报告我们位于[snuffedout_country.GetName]附近的特工小队已经错过了几个检查点。考虑到这次行动的性质，我们预料到他们不能维持频繁的联系。然而，虽然感到遗憾，我们的间谍首脑坚信这支小队是失踪了。

如果我们能够成功地掩盖痕迹，[from.GetName]行动可能被挽救。我们得发挥我们的破译对抗[snuffedout_country.GetAdj]的加密的优势。
texts.en:
Spymaster [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] reports that our team of operatives near the [snuffedout_country.GetName] has missed a number of checkpoints. Given the nature of this operation, we had already anticipated them being unable to maintain frequent contact. However, our Spymaster is regrettably confident that by now, the team has been lost.

Operation [from.GetName] may be rescued if we can successfully cover our tracks, pitting our Codebreaking against [snuffedout_country.GetAdj] Encryption.

texts.zh:
尽管耗费了大量人力物力，消耗了许多间谍首脑[fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName]在[snuffedout_country.GetName]积累的成果，我们终于确保了行动的安全性。所有松动的口子都被堵上；所有掩护身份都被抛弃掉。一支全新的特工队伍将替代原来的人员，在我们的间谍首脑亲自注视下执行着完全不同指令。

与此同时，[snuffedout_country.GetAdj]依然没有注意到我方的存在。
texts.en:
Though it has greatly taxed the resources of Spymaster [fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName]'s work in the [snuffedout_country.GetName], operational security has been reasserted. All loose ends have been covered; all cover identities discarded. A new team of operatives will take over from here, enacting a subtly different set of orders under our Spymaster's watchful gaze.

The [snuffedout_country.GetAdj], meanwhile, still seem oblivious to our presence.

texts.zh:
我们最担心的事情成了真：我们最近在[snuffedout_country.GetName]失去的特工曝光了我们大部分[fromfrom.GetName]行动的细节。

我们的全部间谍网都经过了妥善安排，确保在正常情况下，只有极其不周密的证据才会追溯到我们执行的隐秘行动。然而，在当下的情况，我们完全无法确认何种情报已经泄露；也没法知道[snuffedout_country.GetAdj]打算如何进行回应。
texts.en:
Our worst fears have come to pass: the recent loss of our operatives in the [snuffedout_country.GetName] has exposed large parts of Operation [fromfrom.GetName].

All our Spy Networks are carefully arranged so that under normal circumstances, only very flimsy evidence could ever implicate us in the covert activities we carry out. However, in this instance we cannot be entirely sure what Intel may have been given away; nor can we know how the [snuffedout_country.GetAdj] might choose to respond.

texts.zh:
我们最近在[snuffedout_country.GetName]损失的特工酿成了严重的后果：我方的整个行动被暴露了。

我们的间谍网处于妥善管理的状态，保证正常情况下，能够为我方特工提供一定的匿名性。然而，在当下的情况，我方的任何行动都会导致严重后果，因为各类证据会导向我们，而[snuffedout_country.GetAdj]绝不会对此坐视不管。我们不知道他们会如何回应，得我们应该做好最坏的打算。
texts.en:
The recent loss of our operatives in the [snuffedout_country.GetName] has had some dire consequences: our entire operation has been exposed.

Our Spy Networks are carefully managed so that under normal circumstances, they afford us some level of deniability. However, on this occasion our actions were serious enough that the [snuffedout_country.GetAdj] are unlikely to ignore even circumstantial evidence which may lead back to us. We do not know precisely how they will respond, but we should prepare for the worst.

texts.zh:
我们位于[from.target.GetName]的间谍首脑，[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]，向我们报告了在[from.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer]内筛查特工项目上的惨痛失败。来自[from.target.GetAdj]首都的发言显示[root.GetOperativeRoleIndefiniteArticle]已经选择叛逃。

看上去[root.GetOperativeRole]对于[from.target.GetName]的文化和主体物种生出了同情，而背离了我们。我们的审查机制本来应该排除掉这样的异样，但是这次却失败了。
texts.en:
Our Spymaster in the [from.target.GetName], [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName], reports a drastic failure in [from.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer] process for screening operatives. Word from the [from.target.GetAdj] capital is that [root.GetOperativeRoleIndefiniteArticle] has chosen to defect.

It seems that the [root.GetOperativeRole] has grown more sympathetic towards the culture and founding ethics of the [from.target.GetName], in opposition to our own. Our screening process has failed in that it is supposed to rule out such flakiness.

texts.zh:
我们位于[from.target.GetName]的间谍首脑，[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]，向我们报告了在[from.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer]内筛查特工项目上的惨痛失败。来自[from.target.GetAdj]首都的发言显示[root.GetOperativeRoleIndefiniteArticle]已经选择叛逃。

尽管我们本应当通过审查排除掉组织里的不忠，但[root.GetOperativeRole]还是被“变节”了——或是通过反间谍行动，或是通过培养对[from.target.GetName]的同情意识，而我们之前并没有注意到。
texts.en:
Our Spymaster in the [from.target.GetName], [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName], reports a drastic failure in [from.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer] process for screening operatives. Word from the [from.target.GetAdj] capital is that [root.GetOperativeRoleIndefiniteArticle] has chosen to defect.

Despite the fact we are supposed to be able to screen out such disloyalty, the [root.GetOperativeRole] has been 'turned' - either by act of Counter-Espionage, or some innate sympathy towards [from.target.GetName] which we were unable to detect before.

texts.zh:
一位位于[from.target.owner.GetName]的特工触发了安装在[from.target.GetName]恒星基地服务管道内的防篡改装置。

他身受重伤，但还是勉力完成了任务，而且到目前为止仍未被发现。然而[from.target.owner.GetAdj]有关部门非常清楚，这起意外太不寻常，近乎可疑。讯问正在展开，我们特工呆在他们那疗伤越久就越容易暴露。
texts.en:
An operative in the [from.target.owner.GetName] has fallen foul of an anti-tampering device, installed in the service ducts of the [from.target.GetName] starbase.

Their injuries are severe, but our operative managed to complete their task and has maintained cover so far. It is clear to the [from.target.owner.GetAdj] authorities, however, that the incident was unusual, bordering on suspicious. Questions are being asked, and the longer our operative remains in their medical care, the greater the risk our cover will be blown.

texts.zh:
一位位于[from.target.owner.GetName]的特工触发了安装在[from.target.GetName]恒星基地服务管道内的防篡改装置。

无人机遭受严重的损害，但依旧完成了任务并保持隐蔽状态。然而[from.target.owner.GetAdj]有关部门非常清楚，这起意外太不寻常，近乎可疑。讯问正在展开，我们的特工在对方的监察下越久，暴露的危险就越大。
texts.en:
An operative in the [from.target.owner.GetName] has fallen foul of an anti-tampering device, installed in the service ducts of the [from.target.GetName] starbase.

The drone has sustained serious damage, but has completed its task and has maintained cover so far. It is clear to the [from.target.owner.GetAdj] authorities, however, that the incident was unusual, bordering on suspicious. Questions are being asked, and the longer our operative remains under their supervision, the greater the risk of exposure.

texts.zh:
一位位于[from.target.owner.GetName]的特工触发了安装在[from.target.GetName]恒星基地服务管道内的防篡改装置。

他现在没法跑太远，除非我们在行动接下来的时间中给予除基本支援外的更多援助，这样他才能确保找到一个足够安全的藏身处。然而不久之后这片区域肯定会进行清理式扫荡。我们的特工呆在[from.target.owner.GetAdj]疆域下越久，暴露的危险就越大。
texts.en:
An operative in the [from.target.owner.GetName] has fallen foul of an anti-tampering device, installed in the service ducts of the [from.target.GetName] starbase.

They are currently unable to move far or else lend more than basic support to the rest of the operation, so they have secured a reasonably safe hideout. There is, however, bound to be a maintenance sweep of the area before long. The longer our operative remains in [from.target.owner.GetAdj] care, the greater the risk of exposure.

label.zh: 我们必须抛下他继续前进。
